aboutTeaser.title: Our Story
aboutTeaser.p1: I started creating desserts out of a passion for baking and a desire to bring joy to people's lives. Every product is handmade with carefully selected ingredients and great attention to detail.
aboutTeaser.p2: From elegant wedding cakes to playful cookies for the little ones, every creation is unique and personalised.

story.p1: It all started in a small kitchen, with a cake recipe inherited from my grandmother and a strong desire to make people happy through special desserts. Since then, we've grown step by step, constantly learning and perfecting our techniques.
story.p2: Today, every cake, cookie, or macaron we create carries the same passion and dedication from the very beginning. We work with premium ingredients, draw inspiration from international trends, and personalise every order according to our customers' wishes.
story.p3: We believe a great dessert is not just a treat for the taste buds — it's an experience that creates memories. That's why we treat every order with the same care, whether it's a grand wedding cake or a box of cookies for an ordinary day that deserves something sweet.
